transfer.stem: Which notes keep the completed change, the necessary condition and the ticket timing correct?
transfer.passage:
Preparing for the school exhibition
Our class prepared a small exhibition. An ordinary jar became a colourful lantern for our display. We also compared two leaves with similar shapes. They did not have to be exactly the same size to have a similar shape.
At the food display, a drawing showed a strip of dough divided into four equal pieces. Our teacher reminded us that four pieces of different amounts would not meet that instruction. A health poster said that clean water was essential for good health. It did not claim that water alone could guarantee good health.
Later, we planned our journey to the exhibition hall. A note said that a nearby path was not suitable for bicycles; it said nothing about every other type of transport. Before we joined the queue, we kept our tickets ready. We did not wait until we were in the queue to start looking for them.

options.text: The jar changed into a colourful lantern; clean water is necessary for health; the ticket should be ready before joining the queue.
The lantern will become a plain jar; clean water alone guarantees perfect health; the ticket should be found after joining the queue.
The jar changed into a colourful lantern; clean water alone guarantees perfect health; the ticket should be ready before joining the queue.
The jar changed into a colourful lantern; clean water is necessary for health; the ticket should be found after joining the queue.

answer.display: The jar changed into a colourful lantern; clean water is necessary for health; the ticket should be ready before joining the queue.
